rules.text: Mechanically fastened roof waterproofing membranes by spot fastening in overlaps and / or intermediate spot fastening in combination with fastener Sarnafast® SBF-6.0 or SBF-S-6.0. Only for fastening roof waterproofing membranes over compressible thermal insulation (not for use on hard substrates).
rules.heading: USES

rules.text: Easy to use and install with recommended tools
rules.heading: CHARACTERISTICS / ADVANTAGES

rules.text: Sarnafast® KTL in combination with Sarnafast® Fastener SBF-6.0 or SBF-S-6.0 is used for the mechanical fastening of roof waterproofing membranes
